name: GlobalFoundries gf180mcu 3.3V AS 7-track (gf180mcu_as_sc_mcu7t3v3)

cap_options.name: mim_3v3
cap_options.notes: gf180 MIM; confirm the 3.3V-compatible MIM stack in the selected metal option

cap_options.name: mom
cap_options.notes: metal-finger MOM; no dedicated model card in the 3.3V AS library, must be extracted

ramp.notes: single-slope ramp: step-to-step linearity and the ramp-buffer settling are estimates; the clock ceiling is the profile's digital ceiling. There is no cap array, so DNL comes from the ramp, not from Pelgrom mismatch.

sdm.notes: second-order 1-bit switched-cap loop. loading_db is the measured gap between the linearized NTF bound and the L1 bitstream simulation at 0.5 FS (9.0 dB, flat over OSR 16..64); it is not a stability margin estimate. Integrator GBW is an estimate. The decimator does not exist, so the reported ENOB assumes an ideal one.

measurement.note: f_max = measured ring-DCO TT frequency (21.07 MHz, PVT 21.07/15.74/26.60 MHz). The 2.7x range ratio is an assumption. Deterministic period RMS 0.11 ps is not random jitter.
measurement.curvature_pct_basis: assumption: 4k x(1-x) tuning deviation fitted to nothing; flagged as unverified

sim.deck_note: the /grid 3.3V AS tree ships only librelane and xschem, no ngspice decks; the ciel gf180mcuD deck is reused and the 3.3V device section must be selected explicitly

digital_ceiling_source: adpll_gen pdk_profiles.json gf180mcu_as signoff_mhz (post-route SS canary)
maturity: post-route digital canary at 3.3V; 3.3V-specific cap data not characterized

analog.notes: the 3.3V AS tree has no ngspice deck; the binding was read from the installed gf180mcuD deck (sm141064.spice, '0.18um 3.3V/6V'): .subckt nfet_03v3/pfet_03v3, nf finger param. Reusing the 5V process deck for 3.3V devices is an assumption worth re-checking against the AS PDK's own models.
